messages:
dylan: Heads up — AcmeCorp was billed twice for the Q2 pilot promo on invoice INV-2026-0423. Looks like both the 'q2-pilot' promo and a manual promo were applied. Net overcharge = $3,200. Need manual credit + approval to process. Link: https://invoices.redwood.dev/INV-2026-0423
maria: Can you drop the invoice PDF and the customer's billing email here? Need the usage reconciliation CSV to verify duplicate credit before we post anything.
sara: attaching screenshot from CS showing both credits applied (they sent the portal screenshot). file: acme-portal-credits.png — customer also provided the billing contact: billing@acmecorp.com
finance-bot: Automated alert — Invoice INV-2026-0423 flagged as duplicate_promo_match. Case ID F-2026-0743. Invoice put on manual hold pending review.
kevin: I approve a manual goodwill adjustment of $3,200 for AcmeCorp given the promo confusion. Please code to GL 6501 and tag project=acme-q2-pilot. Approve for immediate processing. :thumbsup:
alex: Copy — preparing journal entry. Journal template I will use:
```
Debit: Sales Discounts (GL 6501) $3,200
Credit: Accounts Receivable $3,200
Memo: Manual goodwill credit per approval (KEVIN) — Case F-2026-0743
```
Processing now; will post txn id once complete.
maria: After posting, update the invoice notes (internal) and add the billing ticket link: https://billing.redwood.internal/tickets/F-2026-0743. Also add customer communication summary.
dylan: CS confirms Acme OK with the credit. They asked if we can also waive next month's seat surcharge as a gesture — up to $500. Is that within finance signoff?
kevin: Approve waiving up to $500 for next month as a separate goodwill concession. Add separate memo referencing the main case.
alex: Credit posted and invoice updated. Refund txn id: RTX-984210. GL 6501 applied. Internal note: "Goodwill credit per KEVIN approval; case F-2026-0743; waived next-month fee up to $500." Reconciliation entry queued for tomorrow's batch.
finance-bot: Case F-2026-0743 closed by user alex at 2026-03-21T15:05:23Z.
dylan: Thanks team — I'll confirm with CS and close the loop with Acme. :tada:
